body: Minimal flat-vector rounded-square app icon on a transparent background. A deep-teal dial holds a coral-and-white compass needle pointing north. The needle swings clockwise about 20 degrees, eases back, and settles at the exact north position on the final frame. No gradients or text, locked front view.
